description: This source file defines an enum 'ChatMarkdownPreprocessor' with static methods and internal structures for processing and cleaning up chat message markdown content, including stripping envelope headers, message ID hints, inbound context blocks, timestamps, and parsing inline images.

classes.name: InlineImage
classes.description: Represents an inline image with a label and optional image data.

classes.name: Result
classes.description: Holds the cleaned markdown string and associated inline images after preprocessing.

methods.name: preprocess
methods.description: Main method to process raw markdown text, stripping envelope, message ID hints, context blocks, timestamps, and extracting inline images.

methods.name: inlineImage
methods.description: Creates an InlineImage object if the source string contains valid base64-encoded image data.

methods.name: fallbackImageLabel
methods.description: Provides a fallback label for images when the original label is empty.

methods.name: stripEnvelope
methods.description: Removes envelope headers from the raw string if they match expected patterns.

methods.name: looksLikeEnvelopeHeader
methods.description: Checks if a header string resembles an envelope header based on date/time patterns or known channel prefixes.

methods.name: stripMessageIdHints
methods.description: Removes message ID hint lines from the raw string.

methods.name: stripInboundContextBlocks
methods.description: Removes inbound context blocks and fenced JSON sections from the raw string.

methods.name: shouldStripTrailingUntrustedContext
methods.description: Determines if trailing untrusted context should be stripped based on specific patterns.

methods.name: stripPrefixedTimestamps
methods.description: Removes timestamp prefixes from the raw string.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Normalizes line endings and trims whitespace from the raw string.
